reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Tobi Lutke, the co-founder and CEO of Shopify.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Tobi Lutke, the co-founder and CEO of Shopify. I have spoken to Tobi on this podcast twice before, first in 2020 and then again in 2022. Needless to say, a lot has changed since we last spoke, and we start by talking about the biggest change of all: AI.

key_points.text: But I’ll remember this conversation for the next set of ideas we discuss: Founder mode, raising the temperature of an organization.
Tobi embodies the concept of Life’s Work that I believe so much in, and this episode is a shining example of it.
He, along with nine other leaders we believe are doing their life’s work.
